# motor-admin

**Tag**: library

## 简介

Motor Admin allows to create a flexible admin panel with writing less code.
All customizations to the admin panel can be made directly in the UI without
the need of writing any configurations code.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.getmotoradmin.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/motor-admin/motor-admin-rails
- 文档: https://github.com/motor-admin/motor-admin-rails/tree/master/guides
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/motor-admin/motor-admin-rails/issues
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/motor-admin
